purpose: Fresh Gate 3 tranche F ambiguous-follow-up cases that must request clarification instead of guessing.

cases.question: Can I use that Order now?

history.content: I have Onward and Rally available on the General.
Onward costs 1 Command during Movement. Rally costs 1 Command before dice while attacking in a battle you initiated.

cases.question: Does that card stop the movement?

history.content: I'm comparing Stand Ground and Entrenchment.
Stand Ground can ignore movement caused by an opposing card effect. Entrenchment can end opposing movement when they advance onto an adjacent Territory.

cases.question: Does that one make both players withdraw?

history.content: I'm deciding between Mutual Disarmament and Rebuilding Pact.
Mutual Disarmament can make each player discard from Hand before both withdraw. Rebuilding Pact can let each player bank an Asset from Hand before both withdraw.

cases.question: If I lose there, does that Rite reset?

history.content: My selected Rites include Rite of Crossing and Rite of Consecration.
Crossing tracks continued occupation of a specific Territory. Consecration tracks a battle on the consecrated Territory and the attached Overlay.

cases.question: Can that Asset stay banked after this?

history.content: I currently have High Command and Field Command banked.
High Command raises maximum Command to 3. Field Command can be discarded after a 1-Command Order to enable the other 1-Command Order at its next legal timing.
